content.thinking: All protocol tests in group 2 pass. Now let me test the queue draining, CRYPTO semantics, ACK semantics, STREAM/RESET/STOP semantics, flow control, overlaps, and rollback.

arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_proto3.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *

ok = True

# ---- queue draining
ok &= check("drain order and time", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[CRY(0,"0102")])]),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",1,True,[CRY(2,"0304")]),pkt("H",2,True,[CRY(4,"0506")])]),
        key(5,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",5),pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",5),pres(1,1,"accepted","OK",5)],
        conn_open(5), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",6,"010203040506"),cr("A",0)]))
# drain processes only that level; others stay pending
ok &= check("drain only level", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(1,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(0,1,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)],
        conn_open(1), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# drained packet: initial size / layout never rechecked
ok &= check("drain skips size check", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,100,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(1,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# drained packet auth failure
ok &= check("drain auth fail", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,False,[UNK()])]),
        key(1,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","AUTH",1)], conn_open(), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# drained duplicate
ok &= check("drain duplicate", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[UNK()])]),
        dg(3,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(4,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"duplicate","DUPLICATE",4),pres(3,0,"accepted","OK",4)],
        conn_open(4), KEYS(h="live",a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# termination during drain: remaining pending dropped CONNECTION_CLOSED at that time
ok &= check("drain terminates mid-way", CFG(buffer_packets=8), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[UNK()]),pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(1,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,0),pres(0,1,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1),
             pres(0,2,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# CLOSE during drain
ok &= check("drain CLOSE", CFG(buffer_packets=8), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[CLOSE(False,11)]),pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()])]),
        key(1,"H","install")],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(0,1,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1)],
        conn_closed("PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE",1,src(0,0,0),1,11), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# install frees queue slots
ok &= check("install frees slots", CFG(buffer_packets=1), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()])]),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()])]),          # BUFFER_FULL (1 slot used)
        key(2,"H","install"),
        dg(3,1200,[pkt("H",2,True,[PAD()])])],          # queued again (slot free)
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",2),pres(1,0,"dropped","BUFFER_FULL",1),pres(3,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",3)],
        conn_open(2), KEYS(h="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- CRYPTO semantics
ok &= check("crypto basic", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb"),CRY(2,"cc")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",3,"aabbcc"),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto out of order", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(2,"cc"),CRY(0,"aabb")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",3,"aabbcc"),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto highest with gap", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(5,"ff")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",6,""),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto zero-length at offset", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(5,"")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",5,""),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto limit exceeded", CFG(crypto_limit=4), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(4,"aabb")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED",0,0)],
        conn_closed("CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto at limit ok", CFG(crypto_limit=4), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabbcc"),CRY(2,"dd")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",4,"aabbcc"),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto overflow", CFG(crypto_limit=65536), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(4611686018427387903,"aa")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("crypto overflow zero-len", CFG(crypto_limit=65536), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(4611686018427387903,"")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",4611686018427387903,""),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# overlap reject conflict
ok &= check("crypto overlap reject", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb"),CRY(1,"cc")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,1)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,1)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# identical overlap fine
ok &= check("crypto overlap identical", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb"),CRY(1,"bbcc")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",3,"aabbcc"),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# overlap first keeps earlier
ok &= check("crypto overlap first", CFG(overlap="first"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb"),CRY(1,"ccdd")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",4,"aabbdd"),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# crypto levels independent
ok &= check("crypto levels independent", CFG(), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"11")]),pkt("A",0,True,[CRY(0,"22")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(1,1,"accepted","OK",1)],
        conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",1,"11"),cr("H",0),cr("A",1,"22")]))
# crypto rollback on later error in same packet
ok &= check("crypto rollback", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb"),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,1)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# crypto conflict across packets is committed (first packet accepted)
ok &= check("crypto conflict across packets", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb")])]),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",1,True,[CRY(1,"cc")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(1,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,0)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",2,"aabb"),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_proto3.py 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
